kamloops.title: Okanagan communities rally around Bald Range wildfire evacuees
kamloops.description: For many evacuees, the immediate challenge was finding somewhere to sleep, something to eat and the basic necessities they had suddenly left behind.

kamloops.title: B.C. farmer who fled wildfire teams up with chef on sauces to support other producers
kamloops.description: A B.C. chef and a local farmer who lost his home to the raging Bald Range wildfire have teamed up on a project to support other producers hit hard by fires this summer.

kamloops.title: How art is helping Summerland evacuees of B.C.'s Bald Range wildfire
kamloops.description: At a comfort centre for evacuees of the Bald Range Wildfire, art is an escape. Pens, paper and paint are placed on placed on tables, along with stickers and buttons for Summerland evacuees. It is part of an art therapy initiative by the Penticton & District Community Arts council.

kamloops.title: Canadair water-bomber builder feels heat of demand as wildfires rage around the world
kamloops.description: As Canada, the United States and Europe grapple with another brutal wildfire season, pressure is building on the manufacturer of the Canadair "Super Scooper" water bombers to increase production, and on the federal government to bulk order the planes.

prince-george.title: Hatchery tours in Vanderhoof, B.C., offer rare chance to see this critically endangered fish
prince-george.description: Getting a glimpse of an endangered prehistoric fish is easier than you might think.

southeast.title: Metro Vancouver regional parks could be impacted over weekend due to workers' strike
southeast.description: The union representing outside workers at the Metro Vancouver Regional District says that it's pulling workers off the job this weekend, impacting services in 24 regional parks.

southeast.title: After months of debate, East Kootenay will stop changing clocks and stay on mountain daylight time year-round
southeast.description: The Regional District of East Kootenay voted 12-3 to stop changing clocks twice a year and stay on Mountain Daylight Time, keeping the region aligned with Alberta year-round.

all.title: Fire and Climate – a special and timely collection
all.description: The 2026 wildfire season shows us that with increased wildland fire risk, more intense fire behaviour, longer seasons, and fire evolving across many landscapes, a changing climate poses significant challenges to today’s fire regimes and management strategies. The International Journal of Wildland Fire has published a Special Collection to showcase papers from and inspired by […]

all.title: B.C. offering free N95 masks for B.C. Interior as wildfire smoke persists
all.description: The wildfire service says temperatures are expected to slightly rise across central and southern regions while northwest areas will see a slight dip in temperatures.

all.title: Meteorologists are forecasting a 'super' El Niño. What does that mean for B.C.?
all.description: The El Niño weather pattern can affect temperature and precipitation across North America, but what does it mean for British Columbia? And will it affect the wildfire situation?

all.title: What you need to know about B.C. wildfires on Aug. 16
all.description: The B.C. Wildfire Service (BCWS) says it's keeping an eye on an unstable weather pattern that could produce more wildfires in the southern half of the province on Sunday, even as evacuation orders are slowly lifted near some of the province's most concerning fires.

all.title: As wildfires destroy homes, should B.C. make FireSmart principles mandatory?
all.description: Experts say practical measures to keep your home from catching fire are proven to work — and point to the communities have built back smarter.

all.title: Homes across B.C. have been decimated by wildfires. Here's what to know about your insurance
all.description: Hundreds of structures have been lost to wildfires so far this year.  Experts say even those who are fully insured will face a long, complex process as they begin to rebuild.

all.title: What you need to know about B.C. wildfires on Aug. 15
all.description: Thousands of residents forced to flee their homes due to wildfires across B.C. are returning Saturday, and a major highway is set to reopen as some conditions improve.
